releaseScope: 3.3.0 P4: the security domain gains five scenario axes (engagement gate, injection detection, surface hygiene, secrets and supply chain, evidence pack) and the pointable pool grows 6 -> 32 by declaring the 21 upstream pentest skills those scenario cards quote, so a run pins their exact version and digest even though only the routing card is delivered. The `full` default now names its six backbone cards instead of relying on the zero-naming fallback, which with a 32-card pool would deliver ~150k tokens a stage.
openDeferred: No current pointer moved (adoption is per-platform, BP-2).
D-88 (novel- prefix misfiling) and D-89 (21 byte-identical duplicate releases) stay open; this release consumes the -security twin and renames nothing.
